Bloomberg yesterday reported that Apple has collaborated with LG to develop a series of brand-new smart home accessories, which will be launched under the LG brand, with leaked images showing the appearance of smart door locks, thermostats, and temperature sensors.

Images reveal three Home accessories that Apple reportedly developed for LG

Apple is rumored to release a long-awaited major revamp of its Home products next week. The company will introduce a brand-new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini, along with an entirely new product category that has been referred to as the 'HomePad' by observers.

However, Bloomberg's report yesterday revealed another piece of the puzzle in Apple's Home product lineup. The company has collaborated with LG to develop brand-new Home accessories, which will be launched under the LG brand.

According to reports, these accessories include smart door locks, thermostats, temperature sensors, video doorbells, indoor cameras, outdoor cameras, and floodlight cameras.

Today, leaker pdfu shared the first images of three of these products: a smart door lock, a smart thermostat, and a temperature sensor.

Top comment by HalfwitWizard

Even if Apple considers it HomeKit-compliant, LG still puts me off.

pdfu's post on X also contained new details about these products.

For example, the smart deadbolt lock features a rotatable keypad, with built-in settings such as a 'touchpad halo, door-left-open audio alert, and lock sound volume,' and supports features like auto-unlock.

Mark Gurman previously noted that these new products won't be ready to ship as quickly as Apple's new HomePod and Apple TV. However, there is a good chance they will still be mentioned by Apple at next week's event.

What are your thoughts on these home accessories designed by Apple and manufactured by LG? Feel free to share in the comments section.

Best Apple Home Accessories

  • eufy 4K camera that supports HomeKit Secure Video
  • Aqara smart door lock with Apple Home Key and UWB support
  • HomeKit garage door opener
  • HomeKit smart plug four-pack
  • Aqara smart thermostat with adaptive temperature feature
